lsof.timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for kernel functions (stat, lstat, readlink) that might block. See -S option. Minimum is 2, default is 15.

lsof.avoid_kernel_blocks.description: If true, lsof avoids kernel functions that might block (see -b). Requires alternate device numbers in mount table.

lsof.device_cache_func.description: Device cache file function: 'b' (build), 'r' (read only), 'i' (ignore cache), 'u' (read/update). Corresponds to -D option.

lsof.suppress_warnings.description: If true, suppress warning messages. Corresponds to -w option.

lsof.inhibit_host_name_lookup.description: If true, inhibits conversion of network numbers to host names. Corresponds to -n option.

lsof.inhibit_port_name_lookup.description: If true, inhibits conversion of port numbers to port names. Corresponds to -P option.
